title: Pouting Pearl Peeper
statement: This thumb-sized octopus has opalescent skin that shifts from pearl-white to soft rose. It lives in a tilted teacup at the back of the tank, peeking out with a single large eye, and 'pouts' — flashing stormy grey — whenever a shadow passes the glass; left alone for a moment, it blushes pink and juggles a bubble between its arms like a tiny pearl.
